zh: 週四美股小幅收低：標普 500 跌約 0.4% 收 7,592.40 點，道瓊少 189.40 點收 52,297.09，那斯達克綜合指數少 100.10 點收 25,366.09。開盤一度重挫近 1%，尾盤收回大部分跌幅；羅素 2000 跌約 1.4% 至 1.7%（約 2,799 點），明顯比大型股弱。大型指數表面平穩，但小型股對利率更敏感，這一天的壓力主要落在它們身上。
en: US stocks closed slightly lower on Thursday: the S&P 500 fell about 0.4% to 7,592.40, the Dow lost 189.40 points to 52,297.09 and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 100.10 points to 25,366.09. Stocks were down nearly 1% at the open but recovered most of it; the Russell 2000 fell roughly 1.4% to 1.7% (about 2,799), clearly weaker than large caps. The big indexes looked calm, but small caps are more rate-sensitive and took most of the pressure.

道瓊 ETF，約 -0.36%
羅素 2000 ETF，約 -1.6%，明顯落後

zh: Nvidia（NVDA）執行長黃仁勳辭職，財務長 Colette Kress 出任代理執行長；開盤股價一度重挫約 14%，收盤只跌約 4.3%，但已較歷史高點低約 27%。據報導董事會正調查他與一名被懷疑是中國政府特工之女性的關係，另有《紐約時報》報導他的另一段關係；這些屬於報導與指控，並非已確認的調查結論。分析師的看法是 Nvidia 的 AI 晶片地位未變，真正的問號是沒有黃仁勳之後公司怎麼運作。
en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned and CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO; the stock fell as much as about 14% at the open but closed down only about 4.3%, still roughly 27% below its record high. Reports say the board was probing his relationship with a woman suspected of being a Chinese government agent, and the New York Times reported another relationship; these are reports and allegations, not established findings. Analysts say Nvidia's AI chip lead is intact; the open question is how it operates without Huang.

stocks.n: 收盤約 -4.3%，距高點約 -27%；11/17 公布財報

zh: 10 年期美債殖利率從 4.98% 跳到 5.12%，推高借貸成本與通膨擔憂；布蘭特原油漲 3.3% 至 95.82 美元，起因是川普說「我們不需要跟伊朗達成協議」，能源股應聲上漲，Marathon Petroleum 約 +2.5%、ExxonMobil 約 +1.8%。海外方面恆生指數跌 1.3%，比特幣跌破 7.2 萬美元。房屋銷售放緩、初領失業金小增，顯示經濟降溫但還不到急轉直下。
en: The 10-year Treasury yield jumped to 5.12% from 4.98%, raising borrowing-cost and inflation worries; Brent crude rose 3.3% to $95.82 after Trump said 'we don't need a deal with Iran', lifting energy stocks (Marathon Petroleum about +2.5%, ExxonMobil about +1.8%). Hong Kong's Hang Seng fell 1.3% and bitcoin dipped below $72,000. Slower home sales and slightly higher jobless claims point to cooling, not a sharp downturn.

stocks.n: 能源板塊 ETF，油價上漲帶動
煉油商，約 +2.5%
油氣巨頭，約 +1.8%

zh: Nvidia 之外的消息面個股：Super Micro（SMCI）跌逾 9%，彭博報導美國司法部在調查是否有人協助走私其產品；SpaceX（SPCX）漲約 2%，宣布在亞利桑那州 Cochise 郡建 500 億美元超級運算園區，CLSA 把目標價調到 300 美元；Take-Two（TTWO）跌約 2%，美銀說《GTA VI》首週末要賣 19 億美元才達預期；AMD 獲 William Blair 升評。這些是各自的催化劑，不代表整體風向。
en: Beyond Nvidia: Super Micro fell more than 9% after Bloomberg reported a DOJ probe into whether someone helped smuggle its products; SpaceX rose about 2% after announcing a $50 billion supercompute campus in Cochise County, Arizona, with CLSA lifting its target to $300; Take-Two fell about 2% as BofA said GTA VI needs $1.9 billion in first-weekend sales to meet expectations; AMD was upgraded by William Blair. These are stock-specific catalysts, not a broad signal.

zh: AI 雲端業者 Nebius（NBIS）第三季營收 9.808 億美元、年增 571%，高於預期的 9.075 億美元；淨損 3,750 萬美元，遠小於去年同期 1.196 億美元。但公司把 2026 年資本支出上調到 270 億美元（原 200 億至 250 億美元），全年營收落在 30 億至 34 億美元區間的低端、低於市場共識 33.5 億美元，股價收跌約 17%。這張卡的重點是：營收高成長不夠，資本支出膨脹與展望才是市場在算的帳。
en: AI cloud provider Nebius reported Q3 revenue of $980.8 million, up 571% and above the $907.5 million expected; net loss was $37.5 million versus $119.6 million a year earlier. But it raised 2026 capex to $27 billion (from $20-25 billion) and said revenue would land at the low end of $3.0-3.4 billion versus $3.35 billion consensus, and the stock fell about 17%. The market is weighing swelling capex and guidance, not just growth.

stocks.n: 收跌約 17%，資本支出上調至 270 億美元
同業收跌近 8%，前一日曾大漲 25%
科技大盤對照

zh: 盤後財報三家：Cisco（CSCO）財年第一季營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於預期，第二季每股盈餘指引 1.34 至 1.36 美元，高於共識 1.23 美元，營收指引 180 億至 182 億美元，盤後約漲 2%。應用材料（AMAT）第四季調整後每股盈餘 4.16 美元、營收 104.1 億美元均優於預期，但此前四個交易日已漲約 24%，盤後小跌不到 1%。Cerebras（CBRS）第三季營收 2.31 億美元優於預期的 2.15 億美元，並有微軟的新合約，盤後漲約 13%。
en: After the close: Cisco beat on revenue and EPS and guided Q2 EPS to $1.34-1.36 versus $1.23 consensus and revenue to $18.0-18.2 billion, up about 2% after hours. Applied Materials posted Q4 adjusted EPS of $4.16 and revenue of $10.41 billion, both above estimates, but the stock had already risen about 24% in four sessions and slipped less than 1%. Cerebras reported Q3 revenue of $231 million versus $215 million expected plus a new Microsoft deal, rising about 13%.

zh: 農化大廠 Corteva（CTVA）第三季營收 15.9 億美元，低於市場預期的 17.7 億美元，股價收跌逾 9%，是財報日裡少見的「大型股雷」。同日 Keurig Dr Pepper（KDP）宣布擬發行約 20 億美元普通股，用來在 2027 年初拆成飲料與咖啡兩家公司前償還債務，股價跌近 5%。兩則都提醒：AI 以外的傳統產業，財報與資本結構消息一樣會讓股價大幅波動。
en: Corteva reported Q3 revenue of $1.59 billion versus $1.77 billion expected and the stock closed down more than 9%, a rare large-cap miss. Keurig Dr Pepper proposed a roughly $2 billion common stock offering to pay down debt before splitting into Beverage Co and Global Coffee Co in early 2027, and fell almost 5%. Both are reminders that old-economy earnings and capital-structure news can move stocks sharply too.

zh: 10 月 CPI 月增 0.4%，高於預期的 0.3%（9 月為 0.6%）；核心 CPI 月增 0.3%，高於預期的 0.2%。能源月增 0.7%、食品 0.5%、房租類 0.3%，且房租占整體漲幅超過三成。因 2025 年政府關門導致去年 10 月沒有資料，勞工統計局沒有公布年增率。交易員目前完全計入 12 月 8 日至 9 日會議升息 1 碼，升息 2 碼的機率升到約 13.6%。
en: October CPI rose 0.4% m/m versus 0.3% expected (September +0.6%); core CPI rose 0.3% versus 0.2% expected. Energy rose 0.7%, food 0.5% and shelter 0.3%, with shelter accounting for more than 30% of the headline gain. Because of the 2025 shutdown there was no October 2025 data, so the BLS published no annual rate. Traders now fully price a quarter-point hike at the December 8-9 meeting, with the odds of a half-point hike up to about 13.6%.

stocks.n: 殖利率上行壓抑長債價格
公用事業，高殖利率環境的利率敏感板塊
區域銀行 ETF，升息與存款成本的觀察指標

zh: Fed 10 月以 10 比 2 的表決把利率維持在 3.75% 至 4%，現在官員的語氣偏鷹：達拉斯聯準銀行總裁 Logan 認為還需要再升 2 碼，費城聯準銀行總裁 Paulson 認為進一步漸進緊縮是合適的，芝加哥聯準銀行總裁 Goolsbee 則稱情勢「precarious（岌岌可危）」。另有報導指出，有一位理事傾向支持 12 月升息。換句話說，市場現在押的不是降息時間，而是升息幅度。
en: The Fed voted 10-2 in October to hold rates at 3.75-4%, and officials now sound hawkish: Dallas Fed's Logan sees a need for two more quarter-point hikes, Philadelphia Fed's Paulson says further gradual tightening seems appropriate and Chicago Fed's Goolsbee called the situation 'precarious'. Another report says a Fed governor leans toward backing a December hike. The market is now debating the size of hikes, not the timing of cuts.

stocks.n: 7 至 10 年期公債 ETF，反映中期利率走向
短天期公債 ETF，2 年期利率較敏感

zh: 週五 8:30（美東）公布 10 月 PPI，是 CPI 之後的第二道關卡。道瓊調查預期月增約 0.4%（9 月為 1.3%），年增預期約 6.6%；不同來源的共識不一致（另一處列 0.3%），去年 10 月基期偏低，只要今年 10 月漲幅明顯就會把年增率推高。結果會直接影響 12 月升息 1 碼還是 2 碼的定價，所以對殖利率與小型股特別重要。
en: October PPI is due Friday at 8:30 a.m. ET, the second hurdle after CPI. A Dow Jones survey expects about +0.4% m/m (September was +1.3%) and about 6.6% y/y, though consensus differs by source (another lists 0.3%); the low October 2025 base means any sizable gain lifts the annual rate. The result feeds directly into whether December is priced as a quarter-point or larger hike, so it matters most for yields and small caps.

黃金 ETF，通膨與升息預期拉扯

en: AI supply-chain stocks diverged sharply: Broadcom rose about 5.5% and AMD about 5.9%, while CoreWeave fell about 6.9%, Micron about 1.6% and Nebius about 17%. Money appears to be separating cash-generating chip designers from capex-heavy cloud lessors. That split is more informative than a simple 'AI good or bad' read, because it shows which part of the chain can withstand high rates.

zh: 地緣風險把資金拉向能源：布蘭特原油上漲 3.3% 至 95.82 美元，川普對伊朗協議的說法讓市場重新計入供給風險，Marathon Petroleum 約 +2.5%、ExxonMobil 約 +1.8%。能源是少數在高利率、AI 股動盪的一天仍上漲的板塊。要注意油價上漲同時會推高通膨，與市場正在擔心的升息議題互相放大。
en: Geopolitics pulled money into energy: Brent crude rose 3.3% to $95.82 as Trump's remarks on an Iran deal revived supply-risk pricing, with Marathon Petroleum up about 2.5% and ExxonMobil about 1.8%. Energy was one of the few sectors to rise on a day of high rates and AI-stock turmoil. Higher oil also feeds inflation, which compounds the rate-hike worries.

Schwab's weekly outlook likewise notes flows into staples, health care, utilities and financials. Defensives are not cheap here, so 'defensive' should not be read as 'safe'.

zh: 羅素 2000 週四跌約 1.4% 至 1.7%，約 2,799 點；週二也已因 CPI 偏熱下跌 1.17% 到 2,807.63。原因很單純：小型股的債務有約 29% 是浮動利率，標普 500 公司只有約 7%，升息預期一升，利息成本就直接反映在獲利上。這也解釋為什麼大型指數只跌 0.4%，小型股卻跌近 1.5%。
en: The Russell 2000 fell roughly 1.4% to 1.7% on Thursday to about 2,799, after already dropping 1.17% to 2,807.63 on Tuesday on the hot CPI. The reason is simple: about 29% of Russell 2000 debt is floating-rate versus about 7% for the S&P 500, so rate-hike expectations flow straight into interest costs. That is why large caps fell 0.4% while small caps fell nearly 1.5%.

zh: 小型股判讀知識：看懂「浮動利率債務」。小型公司更常用銀行貸款或浮動利率債券，利率一上去利息就跟著跳；利息保障倍數（營業利益除以利息費用）低於 2 倍時特別脆弱。另外，小型股流動性差，同一則壞消息的跌幅常比大型股深。挑選小型股時，先看負債中浮動利率的比例與到期時間，比看本益比更能預判這種環境下的風險。這是知識整理，不是推薦。
en: Small-cap reading tip: understand floating-rate debt. Smaller firms rely more on bank loans or floating-rate bonds, so interest costs jump when rates rise; an interest-coverage ratio (operating income divided by interest expense) below about 2x is especially fragile. Liquidity is also thinner, so bad news usually hits harder than in large caps. When screening small caps, check the floating-rate share of debt and its maturity before the P/E. This is education, not a recommendation.

en: Hornbeck Offshore (HOS) operates offshore oil and gas support vessels. Per Form 4 roundups, CEO Todd Hornbeck recently bought about $1.5 million of stock at roughly $5.28-5.48 in the open market. Only this single signal is confirmed; analyst coverage and the latest results are unverified, so it does not yet meet the double-neglect test and goes on the watch list. Risks are the oil and offshore-drilling cycle and limited public data. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

On November 6 CEO Chae Lee bought 70,000 shares at about $2.15-2.27, roughly $150,000, a small but self-funded purchase. zh: 判讀卡：看到議員的申報，先記五件事。一，法定申報期限最長 45 天，所以看到的是舊資料；上面這筆從交易到申報只隔 10 天，算快的。二，金額只給區間，不是實際數字。三，很多交易是配偶或信託帳戶執行。四，AMAT 在週三之前的四個交易日已漲約 24%，跟單者實際買到的價位早已不同。五，選擇權的履約價與到期日比股票本身更有資訊量。這不是買賣訊號，也不暗示任何不當行為。
en: Reading tip: five things to remember about congressional filings. One, the legal deadline is up to 45 days, so you are seeing old data; the Gottheimer trade above was filed after only 10 days, which is quick. Two, amounts are ranges, not exact figures. Three, many trades are made by spouses or trust accounts. Four, AMAT had already risen about 24% in four sessions by Wednesday, so a follower would pay a very different price. Five, option strikes and expiries carry more information than the stock itself. This is not a trading signal and implies no wrongdoing.
